report.summary: Consolidated verification from v-index and v-llm-judge-reliability. 6 confirmed actionable findings from v-index, 5 undecidable across both. Ranked by blast radius. No disagreements.

risks.description: Docstring guarantees about documents/types/wiki layering cannot be verified without build_index implementation.
Concurrency and Windows file handle issues cannot be assessed with truncated _per_file_pass.
Over-reliance on LLM judges for code correctness without test verification may introduce subtle bugs.
Position and verbosity biases can skew results if not controlled.
Ensemble approaches increase cost and latency.

todos.title: Fix _collect early return when max_files=0
todos.description: In _collect, guard early exit: `if max_files > 0 and len(out) >= max_files: return out` instead of `if len(out) >= max_files: return out`. Otherwise, with default max_files=0, it returns after one file, silently dropping the rest. Verify all callers.

todos.title: Implement and test exclusion logic for documents/types/wiki
todos.description: Ensure documents, types, and wiki are excluded from modules, edges, etc., as per docstring. Missing exclusions could cause index bloat or cross-module contamination. Needs opt-in logic and tests.

todos.title: Add tests for filesystem atomicity with content-keyed cache under concurrent access
todos.description: Implement parallel write tests to verify atomicity of cache updates. Corruption would silently break cached results.

todos.title: Review _per_file_pass for process pool order and Windows compatibility
todos.description: Inspect full _per_file_pass (currently truncated) to confirm process pool results are correctly ordered and that Windows file handle limits are handled. Order errors could cause non-deterministic output; Windows issues could crash.

todos.title: Obtain complete build_index and _per_file_pass code
todos.description: Verification of docstring guarantees and concurrency is blocked by missing/truncated code. Retrieve full implementations to enable proper review.
